# Idea Paper (ICSE SEET 2027)

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Page limit** | Max **5 pages**, plus **1 page of references** (strict; violations are desk-rejected) |
| **Definition** | Must present a new SE education and training idea with a **proposed formal evaluation strategy**, possibly including preliminary or informal results. |
| **Evaluation criteria** | Relevance, Significance, Soundness, Presentation (see [criterion definitions](../../evaluation-criteria)) |
